governanceBody.description: UUID of the GovernanceBody this participant is a member of. Materialises the governanceBody relation (previously declared only in x-openregister-relations, which OpenRegister does not turn into a queryable property) so the body members tab can filter participants per body. Empty/absent = not linked to a body.

UUID of the GovernanceBody this meeting belongs to. Materialises the governanceBody relation as a real property so per-body meeting filters and the totalParticipantCount/presentParticipantCount aggregations (which filter on @self.governanceBody) can resolve.

processTemplate.description: Identifier of the default process template assigned to this body (built-in catalogue id, e.g. standard-decision; becomes an OR object reference once the process-configuration capability ships template objects). Applies when no specialized template is chosen for a decision.

additionalTemplates.description: Identifiers of specialized process templates available to this body for specific decision types (e.g. statute-amendment, board-election), in addition to the default processTemplate.
